title: What Happens When Your Spiritual Energy Awakens? (1990-03-09)
description:
Trapped in endless thoughts and unfulfilled desires? Discover how to awaken your inner energy and experience true thoughtless awareness.

This public program explains how awakening our living inner energy transforms endless desires into deep peace. Shri Mataji answers diverse questions from seekers before culminating in a guided self-realization meditation to experience the cool breeze of the Spirit on the central nervous system.

Key Topics:
• 💭 Understanding the difference between pure desire and the endless economic loop of human wants that leave us dissatisfied
• 🧠 Experiencing thoughtless awareness - how to become the peaceful witness rather than drowning in the waves of thoughts
• 💬 Q&A insights covering Karma Yoga, true integration of chakras, and why genuine spiritual awakening cannot be forced
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - feel the awakening of your Kundalini and cool vibrations on your central nervous system

“Yoga cannot be artificial. It has to be a living process, it has to be spontaneous. 'Yoga' means the union with the Divine.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• What chakra is related to integrity? And how to work on that chakra to keep oneself strong?
• What is difference between Sahaja Yoga and Raja Yoga?
• If one has a problem in one particular chakra, you don't necessarily focus on that chakra, you must focus on the whole?
• The colors of the chakras are basically the colors of the spectrum?
• Could You give some advice on how to be non-judgmental - not to judge others?
• Mother, is it possible that once you become realized, you can fall back?
• Can You explain the process You use to raise the kundalini?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to stop negative thought loops and find mental peace?
• What is the spiritual meaning of the witness state?
• How to let go of spiritual guilt and forgive yourself?

Have you ever experienced moments of absolute mental silence where you just witness beauty without thinking? Share your experience below!
